content: I used an electric screwdriver for this step again, finished tightening by hand. Made it way easier
Pay attention to the orientation of the silicone, they're pointing down.

I pre-threaded the nozzle parking plates by placing each plate along the edge of my work table with the metal plates hanging over the edge of the table facing down and then pre-threaded each hole.

I attached each nozzle plate holder to the metal profile by putting the cardboard electronics box under the metal profile for support.
Pre-threading with a screw will definitely help making this easier. Without you are very difficult to get the part mounted in my experience.

replies.content: I wish I would have done this on step 70 when the piece could be flat.
yep.  Even when pre-threading it was a bit difficult to get them started.  felt impossible doing it all at one go.
